correctness.rationale: Xu–Wang 2025 model (1.2) has independent diffusion components E(σ21+σ22 E), I(σ31+σ32 I). Itô on log P where P=ρ1E+ρ2I gives exact nonnegative subtraction Q=(ρ1²E²(σ21+σ22E)²+ρ2²I²(σ31+σ32I)²)/(2P²). With a=ρ1E/P,b=1−a, quadratic minimization gives δ*=σ21²σ31²/[2(σ21²+σ31²)]. Choosing E=a*ε/ρ1,I=b*ε/ρ2 proves sharpness despite nonlinear terms. Actual Example 5.2 σ21=σ31=.2, σ22=σ32=1 gives .01, contradicting paper’s claimed uniform .25; published exponent −.0651 with only that correction becomes +.1749. Independent ray evaluation at ε=1,.1,.001,10⁻⁶ returned .05241,.012698,.01002528,.0100000253, consistent with the analytic limit. This refutes that lower-bound step and certificate, NOT the theorem’s truth or disease dynamics.

value.rationale: A sharp counterexample to a central state-independent Lyapunov estimate is substantively useful: a reported extinction regime in the motivating model no longer follows from its printed sufficient bound, and quadratic noise cannot act as boundary-uniform damping.
